t: Putney Hospital stood here, west of Putney town centre, in the London Borough of Wandsworth. It was a public hospital, and it's remembered today for one famous birth. Phil Collins was born here in 1951. He became the drummer and later lead singer of Genesis, and then a hugely successful solo artist. Between 1982 and 1990 he scored three UK and seven US number-one singles as a solo performer.
